Class RMIServerConnection

java.lang.Object
org.adsl.client.network.rmi.RMIServerConnection
All Implemented Interfaces:
ServerConnection
public class RMIServerConnection extends Object implements ServerConnection
ServerConnection implementation that communicates with the server via Java RMI. Looks up the "GameServer" stub from the RMI registry, exports a RemoteClientStubImpl as the callback object, and forwards all client requests through RemoteServerService.sendRequest().

    • connect

      public void connect(String ip, int port) throws Exception
      Looks up the "GameServer" remote object in the RMI registry at ip:port, exports a RemoteClientStubImpl as the callback object for incoming responses, and registers it with the server.
      Specified by:
      connect in interface ServerConnection
      Parameters:
      ip - host name or IP address of the RMI registry
      port - port the RMI registry is listening on
      Throws:
      Exception - if the registry lookup, stub export, or server-side connect call fails

    • disconnect

      public void disconnect() throws Exception
      Notifies the server of this client's disconnection and unexports the local callback stub. Safe to call multiple times: only the first call performs any work.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in interface ServerConnection
      Throws:
      Exception - never thrown directly; errors during disconnection are caught and logged
